sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:167043
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 21605 of 2021

Applicant :- Rajeev
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Karunesh Narayan Tripathi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed today on behalf of the applicant, is taken on record.

2. Heard Sri S.K. Tripathi, Advocate holding brief of Sri Karunesh Narayan Tripathi, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Manav Chaurasia, learned AGA for the State-respondent.
3.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
213 of 2020, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Bhuta, District Bareilly, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

4. FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and his family members and according to the FIR, marriage of the applicant was performed with the deceased in the year 2015 and after marriage, applicant and his family members tortured the deceased for want of motorcycle and Rs.
50,000/- and on 25.7.2020, informant received an information that due to the torture of the applicant and his family members his daughter i.e. deceased committed suicide by ablazing herself.

Rajeev vs State Of U.P. on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74969540/
1 5.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is husband of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and harassment, he has been made accused in the present matter.

6. He further submitted that actually his wife i.e. deceased accidentally caught fire and immediately,
after the accident, uncle of the applicant admitted her in the hospital and this fact is evident from the information given by the hospital to the police which has been annexed as annexure SA-1 to the supplementary affidavit dated 20.7.2023 but in spite of the best efforts of the doctor, wife of the applicant expired.

7. He further submitted that although initially informant made allegation against the applicant in the FIR and in his statement recorded during investigation but when he appeared before the trial court then before trial court, he did not support the prosecution case and stated that his daughter accidentally caught fire and he was declared hostile and his statement has been annexed alongwith the rejoinder affidavit dated 21.4.2023.
8.
He further submitted that applicant is in jail in the present matter since 26.10.2020 i.e. for more than two and a half years.

9. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that wife of the applicant died within seven years of her marriage due to burn injury in her matrimonial home and there was allegation of demand of dowry but could not dispute the fact that from the record, it reflects that after incident uncle of the applicant admitted the deceased in the hospital and during trial,
informant i.e. father of the deceased has declared hostile and applicant is in jail in the present matter since 26.10.2020 i.e. for more than two and a half years.
10.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

11. Although, applicant is husband of the deceased and his wife died under abnormal circumstances due to burn injuries in her matrimonial home within seven years of her marriage and there was also allegation of demand of dowry but from the record, it further reflects that uncle of the applicant admitted the deceased in the hospital after the incident and during trial, informant of the case has declared hostile and he also stated before the trial court that accidentally deceased caught fire.
12. Further, applicant is in jail in the present matter, since October, 2020 i.e. for more than two and a half years.

13. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
14. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

Rajeev vs State Of U.P. on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74969540/
2 15.

Let the applicant-Rajeev, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
16. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

17. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
